nameEn: Bachelor of Science in Exercise and Health

bullets: Minimum DSE requirements: 4 core subjects + 2 electives with Level 3 in English and Chinese, Level 2 in Maths and Liberal Studies; Biology or Physical Education preferred
Typical admission score: median 26 points (Best 6 subjects), lower quartile ~24, upper quartile ~28 — accessible to students with strong interest in sports and health
Preferred electives: Biology (for physiology pathway), Physical Education (demonstrates practical sports background), Chemistry, or Combined Science; no strict subject requirements
Interview: Required for shortlisted candidates — assesses sports participation history, understanding of exercise science, communication skills, and motivation for health promotion careers
Alternative entry: IB (26+ points), GCE A-Level (BBB), relevant sports coaching diplomas with outstanding athletic achievements, elite athlete admission scheme
Year 1: Foundation sciences — Human Anatomy, Exercise Physiology, Biomechanics, Nutrition for Health; sports skill development modules; 40 hours practical coaching experience
Year 2: Core exercise science — Motor Learning and Control, Sports Psychology, Health Assessment and Fitness Testing, Strength and Conditioning; laboratory practicals (120 hours)

Year 3: Specialisation tracks — Clinical Exercise Physiology (cardiac rehabilitation, diabetes management), Sports Performance (athlete training, talent development), or Health Promotion (community wellness, corporate health); 300-hour internship

Year 4: Advanced practice — Exercise Prescription for Special Populations, Research Methods in Exercise Science, Sports Management; honours project or community health programme; 400-hour capstone placement
Practical facilities: HKU Stanley Ho Sports Centre with exercise physiology lab, biomechanics motion capture suite, strength and conditioning gym, swimming pool, and outdoor sports fields

Accreditation pathway: Curriculum aligned with American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) and Exercise & Sports Science Australia (ESSA); graduates eligible for certified exercise physiologist registration
Interdisciplinary options: Minor in Public Health, Nutrition, or Psychology; joint projects with HKU Medical School and School of Public Health

Clinical Exercise Physiology: Cardiac rehabilitation specialist at HA hospitals, diabetes exercise programmes at private clinics; requires ACSM Certified Clinical Exercise Physiologist (CCEP); starting salaries HK$25,000-35,000/month

Sports Performance: Strength and conditioning coach for Hong Kong Sports Institute (HKSI), professional sports teams (football, rugby, cricket), or private athletic training centres; HK$20,000-40,000/month depending on athlete level

Health Promotion & Corporate Wellness: Wellness programme manager at corporations (banks, insurance companies), community health centres, or NGOs (Hong Kong Cancer Fund, Heart Foundation); HK$22,000-32,000/month
Physical Education Teaching: PE teacher via PGDE (Primary or Secondary) at HKU Faculty of Education; requires teaching practice and registration with Education Bureau
Sports Administration & Management: Programme coordinator at National Sports Associations (HK Football Association, HK Rugby Union), event management at Hong Kong Sports Association for the Disabled
Further Studies: Master's in Sports Science (CUHK, HKU), Exercise Physiology (overseas), or Public Health; PhD for academic and research careers in exercise science
Sports facilities: Stanley Ho Sports Centre — 5-minute walk from Main Campus; features Olympic-standard swimming pool, athletics track, tennis courts, squash courts, fitness centre, and sports hall

Exercise science labs: Exercise physiology lab with metabolic carts (VO2 max testing), lactate analysers, ECG systems; biomechanics lab with 3D motion capture (Vicon) and force plates; body composition lab (DEXA, BOD POD)
Teaching spaces: Dedicated sports science teaching labs, seminar rooms with video analysis software (Dartfish), and outdoor practical teaching areas
Student societies: Physical Education and Sports Science Society organises sports competitions, coaching workshops, first aid certification courses, and annual sports science conference
Location advantage: Stanley Ho Sports Centre adjacent to Main Campus; easy access to Hong Kong Sports Institute (Sha Tin) for elite athlete placements and HKSI coaching mentorship
Admission statistics: ~400 applicants for ~80 places (5:1 ratio) — moderate competition; many applicants have strong sports backgrounds rather than purely academic scores
Score distribution: Broad range 22-28 points accepted; holistic review emphasises sports achievements, leadership in physical activities, and genuine interest in health promotion
Athlete premium: Elite athletes (HKSI squad members, national team representatives) receive significant admission preference even with scores below median; HKU has dedicated athlete admission scheme

Comparison with CUHK Sports Science (JS4324): HKU has stronger clinical exercise physiology focus and medical school links; CUHK has larger intake (~120 places) and broader sports management curriculum
Non-JUPAS intake: ~15% of places for international students and mature applicants with sports coaching or fitness industry experience
Trend: Growing demand post-pandemic for health and wellness professionals; corporate wellness sector expanding rapidly in Hong Kong; 2024 applications up 15%

HKU Foundation Entrance Scholarship: Full tuition + HK$50,000/year for DSE 5** in 3+ subjects; elite athletes with strong academic performance frequently qualify
Faculty of Education Sports Scholarship: HK$20,000/year for students with outstanding sports achievements (national team, HKSI squad, intervarsity champions)
Hong Kong Sports Institute Athlete Scholarship: Full tuition + HK$15,000/month living allowance for HKSI carded athletes; requires continued training commitment
Stanley Ho Sports Centre Scholarship: HK$25,000/year for students committed to community sports development or health promotion programmes
ACSM Certification Grant: HK$10,000 for students pursuing American College of Sports Medicine Certified Exercise Physiologist credential; covers exam and preparation course fees
Demonstrate sports commitment: Document your sports participation, coaching experience, or fitness certifications (PT, first aid) — admissions officers value proven dedication over raw scores

Shadow exercise professionals: Arrange observation at cardiac rehabilitation centres, sports training facilities, or corporate wellness programmes; interviewers test understanding of exercise physiology careers
Maintain fitness: The programme includes physical assessments and practical coaching; being physically active demonstrates you can practise what you study
Consider dual pathways: Combine Exercise and Health with a minor in Nutrition or Public Health for broader career options in wellness and preventive health
Leverage HKSI connections: If you're an elite athlete, contact HKU's sports admissions coordinator early; the athlete admission scheme offers significant flexibility in entry requirements
最低文憑試要求：4科核心科目 + 2科選修科目，英文及中文達3級，數學及通識達2級；優先考慮生物或體育
典型入學分數：中位數26分（最佳6科），下四分位數約24分，上四分位數約28分——對運動及健康有強烈興趣的學生可達標
優先選修科目：生物（生理學途徑）、體育（展示實踐運動背景）、化學或組合科學；無嚴格科目要求
面試：入圍候選人必須面試——評估運動參與歷史、運動科學理解、溝通技巧及健康推廣職業熱誠
替代入學途徑：IB（26分以上）、GCE A-Level（BBB）、相關運動教練文憑並有卓越運動成就、精英運動員入學計劃
第一年：基礎科學——人體解剖學、運動生理學、生物力學、健康營養學；運動技能發展單元；40小時實踐教練經驗
第二年：核心運動科學——動作學習與控制、運動心理學、健康評估與體適能測試、肌力與體能訓練；實驗室實習（120小時）
第三年：專修方向——臨床運動生理學（心臟康復、糖尿病管理）、運動表現（運動員訓練、人才發展）或健康推廣（社區健康、企業健康）；300小時實習
第四年：高級實踐——特殊族群運動處方、運動科學研究方法、體育管理；榮譽項目或社區健康計劃；400小時畢業實習
實踐設施：港大何鴻燊體育中心設有運動生理學實驗室、生物力學動作捕捉套房、肌力與體能訓練館、游泳池及戶外運動場
認證途徑：課程符合美國運動醫學學會（ACSM）及澳洲運動與體育科學學會（ESSA）；畢業生符合認證運動生理學家註冊資格
跨學科選項：公共衞生、營養學或心理學副修；與港大醫學院及公共衞生學院聯合項目
臨床運動生理學：醫管局醫院心臟康復專家、私人診所糖尿病運動計劃；需ACSM認證臨床運動生理學家（CCEP）；起薪每月25,000-35,000港元
運動表現：香港體育學院（HKSI）、職業運動隊（足球、欖球、板球）或私人運動訓練中心肌力與體能教練；視運動員級別每月20,000-40,000港元
健康推廣及企業健康：企業（銀行、保險公司）、社區健康中心或非政府機構（香港癌症基金會、心臟基金會）健康計劃經理；每月22,000-32,000港元
體育教學：透過港大教育學院教育文憑（小學或中學）擔任體育教師；需教學實習及教育局註冊
體育行政及管理：體育總會（香港足球總會、香港欖球總會）項目統籌、香港殘疾人體育協會活動管理
進修：運動科學碩士（中大、港大）、運動生理學（海外）或公共衞生；運動科學學術及研究職業需博士
體育設施：何鴻燊體育中心——主校園步行5分鐘；設有奧運標準游泳池、田徑場、網球場、壁球場、健身中心及體育館
運動科學實驗室：運動生理學實驗室配備代謝車（最大攝氧量測試）、乳酸分析儀、心電圖系統；生物力學實驗室配備3D動作捕捉（Vicon）及測力板；身體成分實驗室（DEXA、BOD POD）
教學空間：專屬運動科學教學實驗室、配備視頻分析軟件（Dartfish）的研討室及戶外實踐教學區
學生學會：體育及運動科學學會組織運動比賽、教練工作坊、急救認證課程及年度運動科學會議
地理位置優勢：何鴻燊體育中心毗鄰主校園；鄰近沙田香港體育學院，方便精英運動員實習及HKSI教練導師指導
入學統計：約400人申請，約80個學額（5:1比例）——中等競爭；許多申請者有強勁運動背景而非純學術分數
分數分佈：廣泛接受22-28分；整體評審強調運動成就、體育活動領導力及對健康推廣的真誠興趣
運動員溢價：精英運動員（HKSI隊員、國家隊代表）即使分數低於中位數仍獲顯著入學優惠；港大設有專責運動員入學計劃
與中大運動科學（JS4324）比較：港大臨床運動生理學重點較強及醫學院聯繫較佳；中大收生較多（約120學額）及體育管理課程較廣
非聯招收生：約15%學額予國際學生及有運動教練或健身行業經驗的成熟申請人
趨勢：後疫情對健康及 wellness 專業需求增長；企業 wellness 界別在香港迅速擴展；2024年申請增加15%

港大基金入學獎學金：全額學費 + 每年50,000港元（文憑試3科以上5**）；學術表現強的精英運動員經常符合資格
教育學院體育獎學金：每年20,000港元予有卓越運動成就者（國家隊、HKSI隊伍、大專盃冠軍）
香港體育學院運動員獎學金：全額學費 + 每月15,000港元生活津貼予HKSI資助運動員；需持續訓練承諾
何鴻燊體育中心獎學金：每年25,000港元予承諾社區體育發展或健康推廣計劃的學生
ACSM認證資助：10,000港元予報考美國運動醫學學會認證運動生理學家的學生；涵蓋考試及預備課程費用
展示運動承諾：記錄你的運動參與、教練經驗或健身認證（私人教練、急救）——招生官重視已證明的熱誠而非純分數
跟隨運動專業人士：安排於心臟康復中心、運動訓練設施或企業 wellness 計劃旁觀；面試官測試你對運動生理學職業的理解
保持體能：課程包括體能評估及實踐教練；身體活躍展示你能實踐所學
考慮雙軌途徑：運動及健康配營養學或公共衞生副修，為 wellness 及預防健康開拓更廣職業選擇
善用HKSI聯繫：如你是精英運動員，及早聯繫港大體育招生統籌員；運動員入學計劃提供入學要求顯著彈性
